Alder funding seminar: 2027 grant approval
The approved Alder grant total for 2027 is 18,500 pounds. It covers display cabinets and a touring collection. This is a funding seminar record.

Alder equipment practice ledger
The spare chess clocks are stored in cubby K9. The practice coordinator checks that cubby at the end of each session.

Alder 2027 visitor-survey plan
Mira Fenwick will coordinate the 2027 visitor survey. Responses will be collected at two open afternoons.
